customer.target: US women 50 to 75 who buy beauty products online and have mostly given up on lipstick because it dries their lips, bleeds into lip lines, or no shade suits them
customer.where: United States, shopping on Facebook/Instagram and Shopify stores

behaviours.name: Facebook ad buyer
behaviours.how: Buys things she discovers in Facebook ads and advertorial articles.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Has been charged for a subscription she did not want or got a product that did not work, now distrusts online offers.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Trustpilot and Amazon reviews and looks for photos from women her age before buying.

behaviours.name: Department-store loyal
behaviours.how: Buys her makeup from known brands at Ulta, Sephora or a department store counter.

behaviours.name: Deal hunter
behaviours.how: Waits for buy-one-get-one offers and compares prices before buying.

behaviours.name: Sensitive and careful
behaviours.how: Has sensitive skin or allergies and reads the full ingredient list first.

behaviours.name: Gift buyer
behaviours.how: Often buys beauty items as gifts for her sister, daughter or friends.

objections: $36 is a lot for a lip balm when similar ones sell for $10 to $20

habits: you scroll Facebook most evenings after dinner
you have a drawer of lipsticks you wore once

pitch:
MAHSA pH Lip Balm, from MAHSA (mymahsa.com), a small online beauty brand for women over 50.
A clear balm that turns a sheer pink on your lips. It does not create a unique shade: it is a sheer pink that lets your own lip color show through, deeper the more you layer.
Made to stay moisturizing so you don't need a balm underneath; the full ingredient list is on the product page.
$36 for one, or $59 for two. Free shipping in the US, delivered in about 5-8 days.
365-day money-back guarantee, even if you opened and used it or just don't like the color. One-time purchase, no subscription.
Sold online only, through the website and Facebook/Instagram ads. New product, no customer reviews yet.
